title: XTI Aerospace seeks performance edge over eVTOLs with jet-fuel-burning TriFan 600
summary: New aircraft developer XTI Aerospace has chosen a development path unconstrained by current battery technology as it seeks to outperform the pack of electric
body_markdown:
New aircraft developer XTI Aerospace has chosen a development path unconstrained by current battery technology as it seeks to outperform the pack of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft by offering greater range, speed and payload.


[Read the article](https://www.flightglobal.com/airframers/xti-aerospace-seeks-performance-edge-over-evtols-with-jet-fuel-burning-trifan-600/157511.article)
